newsitem.title: USA: Rawlings Sporting Goods Q2 net up on revenue gain.
newsitem.headline: Rawlings Sporting Goods Q2 net up on revenue gain.

text.p: Rawlings Sporting Goods Inc said Tuesday its earnings in the second quarter ended February 28 rose due in part to higher revenues, an improvement in gross margins and lower interest expense.
The sports equipment manufacturing company reported earnings of $4.2 million, or $0.55 a share, up from $3.5 million, or $0.45 a share one year ago.
Revenues climbed to $52.9 million from $51.4 million in 1997, the company said.
Rawlings said that higher revenues from basketball and apparel products and improved licensing revenues were partially offset by lower sales of baseball-related products.
Rawlings shares closed up 1/8 Tuesday at 9-1/4.
